correctness.rationale: Exact smoothness analysis excludes exactly \(t\in\{2,-2,-1\}\). The Čech-cohomology coefficient formula for \(F_t^{22}\) follows from Frobenius. All one hundred symbolic entries were enumerated and factored to twelve nonzero positions with explicit \(A,B,U\) and polynomial gcd \(t(t+10)\); an independent finite-field expansion of \(F_t^{22}\) at selected parameter values corroborates these identities. On the smooth locus, \(A=0\) exactly when \(B=0\); the four-dimensional star subspace has stable rank two whenever \(AB\) is nonzero because \(3\) is invertible in characteristic \(23\), while the three separate swap blocks contribute stable rank six precisely when \(U\) is nonzero. Polynomial factorizations and irreducible quadratics give precisely ranks \(0,2,6,8\) and a-numbers \(10,8,4,2\) throughout the algebraic closure. The proof is independent of finite-field sampling.

value.rationale: The symmetric sextic pencil is a natural highly symmetric 1-parameter family in the Badr--Bars classification; 23 is the smallest prime within its p>21 tame regime. The sole nonzero superspecial point is the distinguished Hessian-group sextic with 216 automorphisms, separate from Fermat despite identical extreme a-number. The result classifies every geometric p-rank in the family, detects 15 natural exceptional parameters, and demonstrates characteristic-dependent Cartier behavior beyond the earlier characteristic-five calculation. This is a complete motivated arithmetic stratification, not an arbitrary sample or simple substitution.
